metadata.source: WorldClim version 2.1 historical climate normals and elevation
metadata.method: Point sampling at quality-controlled occurrence coordinates with stated uncertainty of at most 10 km; per species mean and 10th/90th percentiles.
metadata.records_left_out_rule: records with coarse (> 10 km) or unstated coordinate uncertainty are not sampled; counts per species are in records_left_out.
metadata.limitations: These are baseline climate and elevation associations at observed locations, not climate-change exposure, habitat suitability, or causal risk estimates. Each record counts once, so heavily recorded places weigh more.
